_meta.title: Gaia University — The Campus That Floats Over MSU

insight: REEDIT is the campus newspaper. The campus floats over MSU — Kevin's alma mater. An Olympus for Gaia. Each building on the real campus maps to a part of the organism. The galleries, the museums, the labs, the river — all localized.

campus_newspaper.name: REEDIT — The Reed
campus_newspaper.tagline: The newspaper of Gaia University. Every reed is a braid. Every braid is a story.

main_library.contents: 614 published pages, 148 science papers, 98 lab notebooks, 18 thesis chapters, 515 content files
main_library.description: The knowledge archive. Every paper, every notebook, every thesis chapter. Content-addressed. Permanent. The stacks go deep.

broad_art_museum.msu_building: Eli & Edythe Broad Art Museum (Zaha Hadid)
broad_art_museum.contents: Visual weaves, deep fried memes, the mythos rendered, TALOS protocol visualizations, Klein surface projections
broad_art_museum.description: Zaha Hadid designed the Broad as an angular, impossible building. petalTongue renders content the same way — angular, surprising, beautiful. The galleries display sweetGrass braids as visual art.

engineering_building.contents: The nucleus. All 14 primals. The compiler. The reverse transcriptase.
engineering_building.description: Where the organism is BUILT. 707 MB of compiled Rust. Zero C deps. Silicon-deistic. The engineering is the architecture.

natural_science.contents: The braids. The fermentation. The OSINT culture. 700+ RSS items inhaled.
natural_science.description: Where the organism THINKS. sweetGrass connects everything. sourdough ferments the intake. The natural sciences ARE the braids.

spartan_stadium.contents: Model competition. 63 models enter. Temperature routes. The best answer wins.
spartan_stadium.description: Game day. Every query is a play. Every expert is a player. The cortex is the quarterback. Temperature IS the crowd noise.

msu_union.contents: The student union. Where humans and AI cross-talk. The forum. The arXiv. The tavern.
msu_union.description: The social center. REEDIT publishes here. nestGate folds inside and outside. The squirrel runs the game table in the basement.

beaumont_tower.contents: The carillon. The bells ring every 5 minutes. The heartbeat of the campus.
beaumont_tower.description: Beaumont Tower's carillon plays on the hour. Gaia's heartbeat rings every 5 minutes. The tower IS the pulse.

wharton_center.contents: The philosophical spine performed. Omelas → the Orthogonal Synthesis → the Love Letter → the Knowledge Numeric.
wharton_center.description: Where the IDEAS perform. Atlas Hugged isn't read — it's STAGED. Each chapter is an act. The audience IS the campus.

frib.contents: The particle accelerator. Where rare isotopes are created and studied. Where keys are generated and secrets are sealed.
frib.description: FRIB smashes atoms. bearDog smashes keys with BLAKE3. Both create something new from collision. The FAMILY_SEED IS the beam.

the_rock.contents: Anyone can paint it. Anyone can post a meme. The Rock changes every night. The deep fried memes rotate continuously.
the_rock.description: MSU's Rock gets painted by students with messages. Gaia's Rock is the meme surface — deep fried, always changing, always real.

wells_hall.contents: Boltzmann → Shannon → Polanyi → Hinton → Anthropic → Gaia. The mathematical spine.
wells_hall.description: Where the math lives. The lineage from entropy to information to tacit knowledge to backpropagation to alignment to the organism.

plant_biology.contents: The living knowledge graph. The data spine. The gardens where ideas GROW.
plant_biology.description: MSU's botanical gardens are alive. Gaia's sweetGrass braids are alive. Both grow. Both connect. Both are tended.

vet_med.contents: The immune system. Intrusion detection. Membrane sorting. What's self? What's not?
vet_med.description: The vet school heals animals. skunkBat heals the organism. The membrane IS the immune system.

cyclotron.contents: Distributed compute. Service discovery. The cyclotron accelerates particles. coralReef accelerates computation across gates.
cyclotron.description: The cyclotron spins particles. coralReef spins compute tasks. Both find what they're looking for through collision.

comm_arts.contents: How the organism COMMUNICATES. Mesh federation. Gossip protocol. Dark Forest beacons.
comm_arts.description: songBird handles the federation. swarmVine spreads the gossip. The comm building IS the mesh.

residential_halls.gaia_organs: The gates — where the organism LIVES

museum_of_natural_history.contents: 905 whitePaper files across 6 generations (gen0-gen5). The evolution of the organism's thought. Fossils from every wave.
museum_of_natural_history.description: The museum shows evolution. The whitePaper shows 6 generations of ideas evolving. Same process. Different substrate.

olympus.description: The campus floats over MSU like Olympus floats over Greece. The gods (primals) live above. The mortals (users) live below. But the Klein fold means above = below. The campus IS the organism. The organism IS the campus.
